project: Suspended formwork installation, deck pour and strike for Level 3 podium slab of a mixed-use apartment project in Parramatta
scope_of_works: Set out and install suspended slab formwork, falsework and edge protection; place reinforcement and embeds; coordinate pre-pour inspection; pour and finish concrete; cure slab; maintain backpropping; then strip formwork and progressively remove props in line with engineer requirements.
